content.user_title: Download Authorized Videos for Offline Use
content.value_statement: Saving permitted online videos manually can make quality, format, and file organization difficult. This skill structures download requests for videos, playlists, audio, metadata, and chosen destinations.
actual_capabilities: Requests downloads from YouTube and other supported video platforms.
Requests MP4, WebM, or audio-only output.
Handles individual videos, URL batches, and playlists.
Preserves available titles, descriptions, and thumbnails.
limitations: Provides instructions only; it includes no downloader script or bundled executable.
Requires compatible download tooling and network access in the host environment.
Platform support, available quality, and metadata depend on the source and downloader.
Users must have download permission and follow copyright laws and platform terms.

use_cases.title: Study offline
use_cases.description: Save permitted lectures or tutorials at a practical resolution for learning without continuous internet access.

use_cases.title: Prepare editing assets
use_cases.description: Download owned recordings with thumbnails and metadata before editing or repurposing them.

use_cases.title: Archive references
use_cases.description: Preserve authorized talks, webinars, or source videos with consistent formats and organized destinations.

prompt_templates.title: Download one video
prompt_templates.prompt: Download this authorized video from [URL] in the best available MP4 quality. Save it to [folder] and report the filename and size.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with one permitted video and a clear destination.

prompt_templates.title: Choose quality and format
prompt_templates.prompt: Download [URL] at [480p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K] in [MP4 or WebM]. Save it to [folder] with available metadata.
prompt_templates.scenario: Control resolution, format, and metadata preservation.

prompt_templates.title: Extract audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract audio from this authorized video: [URL]. Save it as MP3 in [folder] and report the duration and final file size.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an audio-only copy of permitted source material.

prompt_templates.title: Process a video collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Download every authorized URL below at 1080p MP4 where available. Preserve metadata and thumbnails, save under [folder], and summarize completed and failed items: [URLs].
prompt_templates.scenario: Manage an advanced batch or playlist workflow with result reporting.

output_examples.input: Download an authorized lecture in 720p MP4 and preserve its thumbnail.
output: Saved the available thumbnail as lecture-title.jpg.
Reported the destination and final file size.

output_examples.input: Extract MP3 audio from a permitted webinar recording.
output_examples.output: Downloaded the available audio as webinar-title.mp3 and reported its duration, size, and saved location.

output_examples.input: Download an authorized three-video playlist in 1080p.
output: Used 1080p where the source provided it.
Summarized filenames, sizes, and any unavailable items.

best_practices: Confirm download permission before submitting any URL.
Specify the format, maximum resolution, and destination folder in each request.
Check expected file sizes and available storage before large batches or playlists.
anti_patterns: Do not download or redistribute copyrighted material without permission.
Do not request an entire playlist when only selected videos are needed.
Do not assume every platform provides the requested format, resolution, or metadata.

faq.question: Does this skill include a downloader program?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow instructions and requires compatible download tooling in the host environment.

faq.question: Which video platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The skill targets YouTube and other platforms supported by the available downloader. Exact coverage depends on that tool.

faq.question: Can it download playlists or multiple URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow supports playlists and batches of multiple video URLs.

faq.question: Can it save audio without video?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request audio-only output, including MP3 when the available tooling supports it.

faq.question: Can it preserve video metadata?
faq.answer: It can request available titles, descriptions, and thumbnails. Results depend on the source platform and downloader.

faq.question: What legal restrictions apply?
faq.answer: Download only content you own or have permission to save. Follow applicable copyright laws and platform terms.
